_comment: The single source of truth for the demonstration's photographs. tools/build-image-manifest.mjs reads this plus the real files on disk and writes public/assets/images/generated/_manifest.json, so the manifest can never drift from what is actually shipped. docs/BRAND-ASSETS.md is the human-readable version of this file.

sharedSuffixes.base: Professional editorial food and interior photography, natural window light, realistic portions, clean simple composition, warm cream and sage green palette, muted natural colours, no people, no children, no faces, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no signage text, no identifiable real-world location, no famous branding
sharedSuffixes.photo: amateur editorial photograph taken on a camera, natural available light, real materials and real textures, shallow depth of field, gentle photographic grain, natural colours, no people, no children, no faces, no text, no lettering, no logos, no brands, no watermark

thumbnails._comment: Right-sized square thumbnails derived from the menu photographs above, not separately generated images. Each is the source cropped to the largest centred square (what CSS object-fit: cover does) and resized to 240×240 with LANCZOS. The 1024px originals are kept because menu-breakfast.jpg is also used on the homepage at 381×238.

webpVariants._comment: WebP renditions of the photographs above, at the widths the pages actually draw them at. These are the same pixels at a smaller size, not a re-crop, so a page can pick one with srcset instead of shipping a 1024px JPEG to a 380px box. The JPEG originals are kept: they are the fallback for a browser without WebP, and the 1024px rendition is still the right choice on a 3x display. Built by tools/build-image-variants.py.
